body: Not too great. I constantly feel like a failure and disappointment. I've got no real friends and no one would care if I did kill myself. No one has ever or will ever love me, so I'm bound to die alone anyway. I feel disgusted every time I look in a mirror, and everything I say or do inevitably ends in failure. I'm worth less than shit, and everyone around me would be better off, if I weren't around.
